items.title: A finite type monomorphism from an irreducible stack of dimension d into a reduced stack of dimension <= d is generically an open immersion onto an irreducible component
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: 94-line proof fully executed: base-change to a reduced smooth cover, representability of the monomorphism by two named lemmas, the dimension inequality (eq) from the definitional base-change equality plus the in-pool accepted equidimensionality, the etale-local structure of unramified morphisms (named lemma) giving the etale diagram with closed immersion top, quasi-compact and integral replacements, dimension transfer under etale morphisms (named descent lemma), exclusion of the image lying in a component intersection, equality of dimensions forcing the closed immersion V' -> V to be an isomorphism (squeeze: etale inequality plus the closed-immersion reverse inequality plus the accepted constancy on the integral Jacobson catenary V - all materials in span, mechanical assembly), openness of the image (etale open), etale monomorphism is an open immersion (standard named fact), and the final smooth-plus-monomorphism open immersion. No omissions.
